scope: Flexible photography goals, explicit missing-parameter completion, independent-subtask proposals after bounded correction and correct parameter clarification UI

backend.kind: Actual Python modules and Flask clients with temporary SQLite/file projects; external AI, Blender and transport mocked

frontend.kind: Actual app HTML and JavaScript with mocked APIs

static_checks.kind: HTML references, ARIA reference integrity, JavaScript syntax and CSS parsing; no pixel/browser accessibility audit
static_checks.preservationExampleInPlaceholder: 例如：反光柔和一点，颜色和角度不变

notes: A generic photography goal can use one permitted control domain but requires actual related parameter change; unchanged camera values are not described as optimization.
Missing controls parsed by the existing deterministic grammar are computed once from the original effective plan. Valid same-direction vague adjustments retain their AI-chosen step size.
Explicit values, directions and preservation constraints retain validation; model-correction budget remains at most two calls.
Residual photography omissions can become proposals only for independently validated, nonoverlapping original clauses; unresolved clauses and protection text remain unchanged.
Parameter clarification does not open material-part picking; original part selection, confirmation, source guards and idempotence remain covered.
The two missing historical fixture errors are not counted as passes. No live model-quality or real-render acceptance is claimed.
The previous offline preview remains a labelled v5/v6 artifact, not a v7 acceptance result.
